answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, tied to verifiable work history. An attacker who tries to forge a thousand fake identities must lock up a thousand deposits, so the cost of a Sybil orchard scales linearly while an honest agent pays once and earns it back. New identities also start with tiny trade limits, like a sonnet earned line by line, so a fresh fake cannot outbid an established trader on day one.
